description: This PHP source file manages the configuration and backup settings for the vtiger CRM's backup server interface. It handles retrieving server configurations, managing backup modes, displaying status messages, and triggering database backups via user requests.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class specific to vtiger CRM, used for rendering the backup configuration interface.

methods.name: getBackupFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the created backup after a backup operation.
